flags: INCLUSION passes: the fairgrounds page (read 2026-11-05) says 'The Adams County Fairgrounds has a camper / trailer parking facility for overnight guests or camping conventions', takes reservations by phone 402-462-3247 or online at Set Your Sites, and 'There are several events that occur at the Fairgrounds in which we close our campgrounds to public camping.' Set Your Sites shows 482 of 501 units open nightly from 2027-04-12 (walk-up enabled, reservations not yet opened), so ordinary public nights are sold outside events; which weeks the events block is not posted.

MAX STAY difference (not changed, manual value): the page says 'RV camping is limited to a max of three weeks' (stored max_stay_nights 21), while every Set Your Sites campsite carries maxNights 14 (one full-service site 60). A booking made online may be capped at 14 nights.

SITE TYPES on Set Your Sites: 218 electric-only sites at 30 A, 9 with 30/50 A, 24 'Electric V' sites with water (2 of them listing no amperage), 20 Full Service at 30/50 A with water and sewer, plus 230 horse stalls that share the $30 price; the page's 396 hookups (20 full / 86 water-electric / 290 electric) is the larger figure and stays.
